aboutText: Pap's Supply Co. is a one-person shop making die-cut vinyl stickers — plus mugs, zodiac candles, and a few hoodies — for the haunted-coffee, dark-Christmas, cute-spook crowd. Everything's printed to order when you buy it. Pick your poison; stick it somewhere it haunts daily.
heroSub: Haunted coffee, dark Christmas, cryptids, and cute spooks — on stickers, hoodies, mugs, and more.
kitOfferText: Join the haunt list — 10% off stocking-stuffer stickers, first dibs on new drops, no spam.
metaDescription: Gothic die-cut vinyl stickers, mugs, candles, and hoodies. Printed to order.
pageTitle: Pap's Supply Co. — Dark Goods for Daily Rituals
